data.one_liner: Flutter widget for text with animated Read more/Read less functionality
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable widget for displaying text with an optional expandable Read more/Read less button. Dynamically adapts text length based on a predefined maximum line count and animates the expansion and collapse transitions.
use_when: You need to display lengthy text blocks that can be expanded or collapsed.
You want smooth animations during text expansion and collapse.
avoid_when: You require complex rich text parsing or specialized text formatting not supported by standard text widgets.
You do not need animations or expand/collapse functionality.
strengths: Custom labels and text styles for buttons and text
weaknesses: Limited to basic read more/read less functionality
No documentation on advanced programmatic control or callbacks
